physical.anchor: unforced wrist world xyz at3.8s; once aligned, identical partner per task

stage: M0 Track A fixed half-progress probe

schedule.information: Privileged fixed timing, qualification only; same schedule for both endpoints. A2 unchanged, force/proprio/history only.

qualification.evidence: Report all-contact and hold XYZ error/force, direction, active same-state qPD, actual body, foot forces, saturation and recovery. No selected favorable phase.
qualification.note: Operational screening, not statistical significance or proof all possible alpha schedules fail.

stop: One seed/four finite branches. At unsafe physical boundary stop. No training, latent search, amplitude/reward tuning, repeated result selection, direct joint corrections, or old timing tests.
